batch.tagsHint: Tags live in the library, so only skills linked to a library skill can be tagged from here.

confirm.pullDescription: The project and the library both changed. Every copy below is replaced with the library version, and the project's own changes are lost.
confirm.restoreDescription: The project's copy is newer than the library. Restoring throws those newer changes away in every copy below.
confirm.deleteDescription_one: This folder is deleted from the project. A library copy, if there is one, stays.
confirm.deleteDescription_other: All {{count}} copies below are deleted from the project. A library copy, if there is one, stays.
confirm.removeCopyDescription: This copy differs from the library, so deleting it may lose changes that exist nowhere else.
confirm.removeLastCopyDescription: This is the project's only copy of the skill. Deleting it removes the skill from the project.
confirm.pullManyDescription_one: {{count}} of them also changed in the project. Its project changes are replaced with the library version.
confirm.pullManyDescription_other: {{count}} of them also changed in the project. Their project changes are replaced with the library version.
confirm.deleteManyDescription: Every copy of these skills is deleted from {{project}}, for all agents. Library copies stay.
confirm.presetRemoveTitle: Remove the preset “{{preset}}” from this project?
confirm.presetRemoveDescription_one: {{count}} skill copy is deleted from {{project}}. The library copy stays.
confirm.presetRemoveDescription_other: {{count}} skill copies are deleted from {{project}}. The library copies stay.

toast.pushFailedMany_other: {{count}} skills could not be pushed to the library

overview.title: All projects
overview.emptyDescription: Link a project folder to see and manage the skills in its agent folders, such as .claude/skills.

addProject.description: Manage the skills inside a project, find projects under a folder, or link a standalone skills folder.

folder.label: Project folder
folder.hint: Skills are read from the agent folders inside it, such as .claude/skills. Those for the default agent are created when missing.

scan.label: Folder to search
scan.hint: Finds folders that already contain an agent's skills folder, up to four levels deep.
scan.none: No project with agent skills was found under this folder.

linked.intro: A linked workspace is one skills folder anywhere on disk. It stands on its own: it is not tied to a project or to an agent's global folder.
linked.name: Name
linked.disabledPlaceholder: Created next to the skills folder when empty
linked.disabledHint: Leave it empty and a sibling folder ending in “-disabled” is created automatically. Without one, skills in this workspace cannot be switched off.
